title: Exercise: login phishing reported by education teams
summary: In this fictional exercise, a campus and a district received messages pointing staff to an imitation sign-in page.
action: review sign-in and email telemetry for the reported activity

title: Exercise: vendor notice about the district roster connector
summary: In this fictional exercise, a roster vendor advised customers to review connector access.
action: confirm whether the connector is enabled and review its service account access

title: Exercise: campus account takeover reports
summary: In this fictional exercise, a campus reported unauthorized access to several staff accounts.
action: review unusual sign-in activity and verify session revocation procedures
